_schema.description: Shopify product handle -> source Etsy listing. Every Shopify product gets a row, so every old URL has a known destination or is flagged. Below confidence 0.9 or with needsHuman=true, a human checks it. Produced by scripts/lineup-draft.mjs.
_schema.method: handle-suffix: the Shopify handle ends with the last 5 digits of the Etsy listing id (set by the Etsy importer), confirmed by title word overlap. title-only: no active listing has that suffix (source listing no longer active), so the closest active title is suggested. none: nothing close.

row.titleSimilarity: number 0-1, word overlap after stop words
row.pageKey: string | null — the clusters.json page this old URL should 301 to
